Los intereses se calculan siempre sobre: Interest is always calculated on the initial capital, so it is the same every year and the capital grows in a straight line. It is used in operations of less than a year, such as bills or discounts.
Los intereses de cada periodo se suman a: The interest of each period is added to the capital and generates interest in the next period too: the capital grows exponentially. With m periods per year (12 if monthly) and a nominal rate i:
Despejando se obtiene el capital inicial: Solving gives the initial capital (discounting), $C_0 = C_n (1 + i)^{−t}$, the rate, $i = (C_n/C_0)^{1/t} − 1$, or the time, $t = {ln(C_n/C_0)}/{ln(1 + i)}$.
El TIN (tipo de interés nominal) es el t: The TIN (nominal interest rate) is the annual rate that is split among the periods: $i_m = TIN/m$. The TAE (effective annual rate, similar to the APR or EAR) is what it really yields in a year, counting interest on interest:
Por eso los bancos están obligados a dar: That is why banks are required to state the TAE: it allows products with different payment schedules to be compared. For loans, the TAE also includes mandatory fees and expenses.
